cards.name: Makuhita
cards.notes: Added from curator-provided metadata. Makuhita's accidental upright nap follows a determined round of slap-push drills.
cards.whyItBelongs: Accidental nap propped against a fallen log in a moonlit glade. Look closely at the tree trunk behind it to spot the splintered impact craters Makuhita punched into the bark during slap-push drills. True to its Pokédex lore of relentlessly slamming into giant trees to toughen its body, this round sumo trainee completely knocked itself out upright under the full moon. Kurata So’s luminous palette and Makuhita’s soft snoring expression turn an intense workout recovery into pure cozy binder magic.

cards.name: Slakoth
cards.notes: Slakoth from Paldea Evolved 160/193 is included in this guide as a sleepy Pokemon card for collectors building a calm, cozy, or nap-themed binder. As a common card, it is useful for collectors who want the sleepy theme to feel complete beyond only the expensive hits. The card is illustrated by Shigenori Negishi, which is useful context for collectors who like arranging pages by artist as well as by Pokemon. Its low market price makes it one of the easiest sleepy Pokemon cards to add to a binder without stretching a collection budget. It fits especially well in a modern Scarlet & Violet-era binder page built around soft, restful, or cozy card art.
cards.whyItBelongs: Cozy nap between daily yawns. Twenty hours of sleep a day captured in serene green woodland tones by Shigenori Negishi.
